title: Austria’s Outlook Cut to Negative at Moody’s on Budget Deficit
content: Austria’s sovereign credit outlook was cut to negative by Moody’s Investors Service in the latest setback for the government’s efforts to mend its finances.

title: JPMorgan Private Credit Secondaries Head Carter Is Leaving Bank
content: JPMorgan Chase & Co.’s Andrew Carter is departing the firm after about three years of leading its private credit secondaries strategy, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: What Is the Mortgage Fraud Lisa Cook Is Accused Of?
content: President Donald Trump has called on Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook to resign amid a claim by a top administration official that she may have engaged in so-called mortgage occupancy fraud by falsely labeling a secondary home as her primary residence to get better loan terms. Cook hasn’t been charged with any crimes, but the allegation put a spotlight on what experts say is a relatively common type of financial misconduct.

title: Warburg-Backed Avanse Is Said to Mull IPO Delay on US Visa Rules
content: Avanse Financial Services Ltd., an Indian education financing provider backed by private equity firm Warburg Pincus, is considering delaying its initial public offering as demand for loans slows due to stricter US visa rules, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Citi Traders Exit in Latest Latin America Credit Desk Departures
content: Citigroup Inc.’s two remaining traders on its Latin America corporate credit desk in New York have left the bank, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Spirit Downgraded After Borrowing Cash to Reduce Default Risk
content: Moody’s Ratings downgraded the creditworthiness of Spirit Airlines by two notches, to Caa3, after the beleaguered airline drew down $275 million of its revolving credit facility to avert a cash crunch.
